Subject: Redwood Hosted API - enterprise commitment & commercial ask

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and prefix caching demo. We finished an internal review and procurement is ready to move, conditional on a committed commercial proposal.

Quick summary of what they need:
- 24 month committed monthly token volume (see attached projection)
- Requesting a 28% off list unit price for Hosted API usage across the committed term
- Standard SLA, SOC 2 evidence, and a short clause on data residency in US only
- Prefer monthly invoicing but open to quarterly prepay for better economics

I know 28% is a material concession. From our side: MediQuant is offering a three-product upsell path and is willing to commit publicly as a reference customer if we can get near-term pricing certainty. They are aiming to finalize commercial terms by end of month.

Attached: MediQuant_ProjectedUsage_Q1-Q4.xlsx, MQ_SOW_v1.pdf

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate a >20% concession for a strategic, 24-month commitment? If not, please propose the maximum exception we can offer and any required guardrails (minimums, ramp, upfronts).

Best,

Team — forwarding MediQuant's ask. TL;DR: they requested 28% off list for a 24-month committed monthly token contract. Attached projections show peak-month volume ~1.8B tokens and steady-state ~900M/mo in year 1.

My read: strategic reference potential, multi-product roadmap, and healthy projected ARR if we secure the commitment. Risks: heavy discount, multi-region support request later, and churn if usage doesn't materialize.

Proposed negotiation posture (initial):
- Counter: 22.5% off list for 24 months with 6 months upfront or 3 months prepay quarterly (improves cash and de-risks)
- Add guardrails: minimum monthly committed tokens, 30% step-down penalty if realized volume < 60% of committed for any two consecutive quarters
- Require public reference and case study clause (opt-in) in exchange for concession

Requesting exec-level approval for exception >20% (they asked 28%). If we can get signoff up to 25% under the conditions above, I think we close this.

Attachments from customer are included. Please advise next steps — happy to jump on quick sync.

Thanks,
Sofia
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts

Subject: Final: MediQuant rate exception approval (25% conditional)

Team — after reviewing the numbers and Laura's sensitivity sheet I approve a one-time commercial exception up to 25% off list for a 24-month Hosted API commitment provided all of the following conditions are met and encoded in the SOW/Order Form:

1) Payment: client prepays first 3 months at signature; Redwood reserves the right to require 6 months prepay if procurement pushes for more favorable net terms.
2) Minimums: explicit monthly committed token floor; if actual average monthly usage < 60% of committed for two consecutive quarters, pricing reverts to list minus 10% (as Ben suggested) for the remaining term.
3) Early termination: if client terminates before 12 months, remaining prepaid months are retained and a termination fee equal to 25% of remaining committed value is owed.
4) Reference & public case study: concession contingent on MediQuant agreeing to a public reference/case study within 9 months; opt-out revokes discount.
5) Legal sign-off: Legal to add US data residency language and confirm SLA attachment.

This approval is valid until 2028-01-31 and specifically for deal DL-2028-045 / MediQuant Labs. Sales to confirm SOW attachments and update HubSpot with the final commercial summary and terms.

Aditya Rao
